## Checklist

Please confirm the following before requesting review:

- [ ] Public API changes are documented and intentional
- [ ] Behaviour is explicit and deterministic (no background or heuristic behaviour)
- [ ] Changes are fully testable (no reliance on timers or `sleep`)
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated where appropriate
- [ ] Existing behaviour has not changed unintentionally
- [ ] No global state or implicit side effects introduced
- [ ] Code follows the project’s design principles
